configuration: Three motors M2/M3/M4; OneShot125; propellers removed; frame supported; live IMU calibration installed.
pending: Actual running motor stop on RF loss (electrical failsafe and rearm interlock already verified without ESC main power)
Motor, propeller, battery and takeoff mass specifications; thrust margin assessment
Physical propeller selection, installation direction and retention checks before any prop-loaded testing
Prop-loaded stability and PID commissioning in a suitable test setting
Confirm physical CH4-only servo behavior and diagnose/retest uneven liftoff (M3 highest, M4 next, M2 lowest); restore gyro yaw feedback after agreed testing
operator_report_during_throttle_test: All three motors did not rotate.
operator_report_esc_power_on_tones: A tune immediately at power on, followed by another tune a few seconds later; exact tone pattern unknown.
operator_report_signal_ground: ESC signal GND directly connected to Teensy GND and checked by operator.
initial_loopback_note: Input14 followed output2; input15 followed output3; no pulses at input16. Jumper endpoints under investigation; this does not identify ESC protocol.
loopback_method: ESC battery and ESC signals disconnected; output1->input14, output2->input15, output3->input16. Standalone instrument reuses normal commandMotors() unchanged. Neighbor inputs13 and17 additionally observed. Tests run across five pulse patterns and do not verify ESC-end continuity, analog voltage quality, or ESC protocol acceptance.
loopback_resolution: Operator corrected jumper positions. All three intended inputs then matched the intended outputs; widths within 1 us and periods 499..501 us.
current_image: Normal BETA1.3 DShot300, re-calibrated current level pose, yawFeedbackEnabled=false: CH4 direct manual tilt with gyro automatic yaw correction disabled; shaft limit+/-60deg. Roll/pitch angle control, arming, SA and RF failsafe retained. No bench cap or three-second timer. Uploaded and stationary verified:2kHz, maxwork273us, overruns0, mean roll-0.010deg/pitch0.001deg. Uneven liftoff not yet retested.
operator_report_after_capped_cycle: All three motors did not rotate; operator also reported no servo response to S1; servo mode/power under investigation.
operator_multimeter_check: ESC power connection, signal channel continuity, and common ground all confirmed by operator using multimeter.
servo_resolution: Operator found servo signal wire had fallen out. Reconnecting restored normal servo operation. SA=2000 subsequently showed CH6 and S1 tracking.
dshot_spin_physical_result: Operator reports none of the three motors rotated.

yaw_timeout_diagnosis.conclusion: Bench motor timeout clears armedFly; yaw returns to center. User asked to retain timeout and return to ESC debugging. No servo override applied.

beep_first_physical_report: Initially no new sound reported; later operator reported one beep. Paired acoustic confirmation pending.
beep_pair_physical_report: Operator reports no corresponding two beeps; prior isolated sound was heard much later. No acoustic confirmation of DShot600 acceptance.
dshot300_beep_physical_report: Operator heard all three corresponding short beeps, M2 then M3 then M4 at two-second intervals. DShot300 acceptance on all three channels confirmed.
dshot300_spin_physical_result: Operator confirms all three motors started. Final state is SA=2000, throttle=1000, armed=0, all three digital outputs=0.
normal_source_status: Compiled and uploaded normal DShot300 source with yawServoDirection=-1 and no bench cap/timer; 49 post-flash samples: loop500us, maxwork265us, overruns0, ARM0 and all DShot0.
single_motor_host_checks: Passed default zero selection, all 2048 command values for each target, unsafe selection rejection, range cap, disarm and timeout stop.
single_motor_position_direction_status: All positions confirmed: M2 front-left CCW; M3 rear CCW after software reversal, save and power-cycle retest; M4 front-right CW.

M4.other_motors_stationary: not explicitly reported; command telemetry confirms D2=D3=0

M4_noise_report: Operator reports front-right continuous/repeated beeps before M4 spin instructions. M4 selected safely, all running commands zero and USB BEEP count zero. Spin test paused; requested SA stop and battery disconnection plus sound cadence/onset details.

M4_noise_followup.operator_report: Beep group approximately every3seconds, appeared after extended idle; power cycling stopped it.
M4_noise_followup.interpretation: Consistent with idle beacon (inference); ESC firmware and stored beacon setting not read.
M4_noise_followup.MCU_restart_observation: USB device disconnected during power cycle; subsequent snapshot had SEL_M=0 and fresh counters. M4 reselected only after SA stop and low throttle were confirmed.

M3_direction_plan: M3 actual CW differs from planned CCW; operator confirms battery disconnected and phase wires soldered/inconvenient to swap. Preparing M3-only temporary DShot21, physical confirmation, then DShot12 save and power-cycle retest.
m3_direction_host_checks: Passed fixed M3 target, packet vectors21/12, 10 repeats at >=1ms without interleaved zeros, safe idle, abort and cooldown, save only after reverse, one save attempt per boot.
m3_temporary_reverse_physical_report: Operator confirms M3 now CCW, other two stationary, SA returned to2000.
m3_persistence_physical_report: Operator confirms M3 remained CCW after power cycle, other two stationary, then disconnected ESC battery. Fresh MCU counters confirm no reverse or save command was sent during retest.

right_down.result: PASS: roll about+8.4deg, negative roll PID, M4 unclamped request greater than M2. ESC power disconnected; actual motor response not tested in this phase.

left_down.result: PASS: roll about-6.4deg, positive roll PID, M2 unclamped request greater than M4. ESC power disconnected.

tail_down.label: tail_down
tail_down.result: PASS: rear request above front pair for tail-down.

servo_neutral_check.operator_report: Frame horizontal; independent servo supply with ESC battery disconnected; all three motor shafts point vertically upward at S1 center.

servo_direction_measurement.operator_report: M3 tilts left; all three arms move synchronously without binding.
servo_direction_measurement.inference: PWM increased1504->1636us estimate, logical90->102, M3 left gives CW yaw torque. Source corrected to yawServoDirection=-1; manual left/CCW restoring response and CH4 pilot direction physically confirmed.

normal_yaw_corrected_compile: passed; normal source build only, not uploaded

yaw_manual_feedback_check.label: left_turn
yaw_manual_feedback_check.operator_report: Manual left/CCW body rotation: M3 tilted left during motion, returned to center after stopping; SA returned to2000. ESC main power remained disconnected.
yaw_manual_feedback_check.conclusion: Correct restoring yaw sign for tested left rotation; telemetry captured both gyro signs with opposing PID correction. Pilot CH4 direction correspondence subsequently confirmed.

yaw_pilot_direction_check.operator_report: User reports correspondence with requested directions and explicitly confirms CH4 left causes M3 tilt right.
yaw_pilot_direction_check.conclusion: Pilot yaw command direction matches measured linkage and restoring feedback direction; both software signs verified, physical correspondence confirmed by operator.

rf_loss_after_yaw_check.operator_report: Transmitter switched off after low-throttle arming; servo remained centered. ESC main power disconnected throughout.
rf_loss_after_yaw_check.scope: Actual RF loss, disarm and electrical output zero verified; no powered motor failsafe test in this step. Host timestamps do not measure transmitter shutdown-to-failsafe latency.

rf_safe_reconnect_after_yaw_check.operator_report: Transmitter reconnected; host confirmed throttle1000, cut2000, link valid, ready1, arm0 and all DShot outputs0.

rf_reconnect_cut_interlock_observation.source: Prior serial observer output before the safe reconnect capture
rf_reconnect_cut_interlock_observation.observation: During an earlier reconnect within the same test, LINK=1 FS=0 CH5=1000 but READY=0 ARM=0; no automatic rearm. A later reconnect with CH5=2000 restored READY=1 while keeping ARM=0.
rf_reconnect_cut_interlock_observation.scope: Observed receiver-ready interlock; ESC power disconnected.

powered_level_idle_after_yaw_fix.label: powered_level_idle
powered_level_idle_after_yaw_fix.operator_report: ESC main battery connected; startup completed and all motors stationary.

powered_level_spin_after_yaw_fix.stop_observation: CH3 returned to1000 while SA remained1000 and all DShot outputs became0; 3-second timeout subsequently latched; later SA2000 reset timeout. Therefore this run did not isolate SA cut with nonzero throttle.

right_fixed_pre_power.label: right_fixed_pre_power
right_fixed_pre_power.operator_report: Right/M4 side lowered approximately10degrees and frame fixed; ESC main power disconnected.
right_fixed_pre_power.interpretation: Roll10.91deg, Pitch-7.45deg. M4 minus M2 pre-clamp demand=0.03781 at zero throttle, correct roll correction. Coupled pitch is common to front pair, so front pair comparison remains valid. Powered response pending.

timing_later_observation.note: Later fixed-tilt observation includes3us maximum period overshoot; nominal loop remains2kHz. Do not report cumulative maximum as500 after this point.

powered_right_down_response.operator_report: Right/front M4 started before left/front M2.
powered_right_down_response.conclusion: Powered roll correction direction confirmed: M4 electrical command exceeded M2, consistent with physical start order for right-down fixed pose. No tachometer or prop-loaded stabilization measured.
powered_right_down_response.stop_observation: Throttle fell below output threshold before SA cut; timeout latched before later SA reset. Dedicated SA cut at running throttle still pending.

powered_sa_cut_verified.operator_report: SA returned to2000 and the motors immediately stopped.
powered_sa_cut_verified.scope: SA-controlled powered shutdown verified before bench timeout, at CH3=1062. Host polling only bounds transition between samples; not a precise latency measurement. Earlier attempts in this capture include throttle returns and timeout; final attempt isolates SA.

nose_fixed_pre_power.label: nose_fixed_latest
nose_fixed_pre_power.operator_report: Nose/+X side lowered and frame fixed, with ESC main power disconnected.
nose_fixed_pre_power.conclusion: Pitch10.99deg, Roll0.27deg. Both front motor pre-clamp demands exceed rear M3; correct pitch correction sign. Powered response pending.

powered_nose_down_response.operator_report: M2 and M4 started first, before rear M3.
powered_nose_down_response.conclusion: Powered pitch correction direction confirmed for fixed nose-down pose: front motor commands exceed rear and physical start order agrees. Not a measurement of prop-loaded stability or RPM.
powered_nose_down_response.cycles_note: Capture includes repeated arm attempts and bench timeout resets; output cap239 remained active throughout. Raw throttle maximum1193 exceeded requested1100 upper target; retain bench protections.

servo_configured_endpoint_clearance.operator_report: S1 can reach both stops safely; user confirms endpoint clearance.

hardware_assumption_for_first_hover.operator_report: Motor, propeller, battery and airframe configuration copied one-to-one from the author Cyclone project. ESC and servo are the previously documented actual RuiBet65A and270deg/30kg units.
hardware_assumption_for_first_hover.limits: Author page does not state takeoff mass or explicit propeller dimensions in text; actual thrust-to-weight ratio not measured. No numeric mass, prop size or thrust margin inferred.

normal_first_hover_flash.scope: Normal source image uploaded, no BENCH or TIMEOUT diagnostics, disarmed and output zero, valid receiver. No ESC main or servo power during upload. Normal build removes bench cap and three-second timer; retains normal arming, cut, RF failsafe and DShot fault lockout.

normal_powered_acceptance_capture.operator_report: User reports requested acceptance test passed; then attempted takeoff and observed uneven arm lift.
normal_powered_acceptance_capture.scope: Serial capture confirms normal-image continuous running >10seconds, no three-second timeout, SA cut and2kHz timing. It did not capture an RF loss transition in its300second window; powered RF-stop result is operator-reported, not corroborated by this capture.

uneven_liftoff_report.initial_report: Two rotors lifted, one did not; operator initially selected M3 as lowest.
uneven_liftoff_report.correction: Confirmed by operator: rear M3 highest, front-right M4 next, front-left M2 lowest.
uneven_liftoff_report.action_requested: Recalibrate current level pose and temporarily disable automatic yaw feedback; operator selected CH4 manual tilt.
uneven_liftoff_report.status: Completed requested level re-calibration and CH4 manual-yaw firmware upload; stationary level verified. Cause of unequal liftoff remains unconfirmed and actual liftoff has not been retested.

manual_yaw_recalibrated_flash.verification_scope: Post-flash stationary disarmed verification; manual yaw independence and limits checked by host mixer tests, physical armed servo behavior not rechecked after this flash.
